videoTitle: Why You Can't Sit Cross-Legged (It's Not What You Think)
videoDescription: Struggling to sit cross-legged? The problem isn't flexibility—it's restricted hip rotation and specific tight muscles most people never stretch. Find out which four stretches actually work at mindtivate.com
script: Think you can't sit cross-legged because you're not flexible? Wrong. It's actually restricted external rotation in your hip socket, and the real fix targets four specific muscle groups most stretching routines completely ignore...
